steps.content: After leaving the museum, Enfer brings you to a residence near the suburbs.
The carved black marble door reminds you of the Gate of Hell in the museum.
Seeing you gazing at the door, Enfer guesses your thought.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Scared?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Relax, it doesn't have that kind of power.
Enfer smiles and drags you into the depths of the residence.
You pass by a poorly maintained garden. Had all of these withered flowers bloomed, they would have looked the same as the flowers in that painting.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Go inside the small room behind the garden, walk downstairs, and you'll find my studio.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Be careful. The stairs there are a little steep.
Pushing open the door and taking the stairs step by step, you and Enfer gradually sink into darkness.
Just as you begin to feel worried, with a snap, Enfer switches on a lamp carved into a grimacing pixie.
The pale light illuminates the path beneath your feet and somehow you feel that it leads straight to hell.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But... twenty years ago, this was once my father's studio too.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: He created countless works here...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Including that sculpture, The Truthful One.
It looks like... a studio full of stories.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Would you like to hear... those stories that took place in its belly?
Enfer is walking ahead of you. She lifts her head to look up at you while you bow your head slightly.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Did you notice we're in a perfect position... for a hug?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Yes, in exchange for the stories, but not now.
Enfer continues walking down and switching on the lights on the way. The blinding white lights keep extending, unraveling with the stories Enfer is telling.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Though I was born into a family of artists... there was nothing artistic about the union of those two.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Just like breeding purebred cats, when you put two sets of excellent genes together, you're bound to get even more excellent genes.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Heh...
Enfer presses the button. White light pours down, coating her with a layer of fragile and blinding light.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: My mother tried to love her husband and tried to manage this home that appeared happy and artsy to outsiders.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: She was a master of oil painting. As soon as I learned how to walk, she taught me how to hold a paintbrush.
Finishing the last step, you feel that you've entered a spacious room. The lights are switched on one after another, and you watch Enfer walk forward.
As the girl before you is telling her stories, she picks up a long chisel on the workbench, swings it in the air like she's painting something, and finally lowers her hand limply.
As if she's spilled paint outside the canvas, and the painting has lost its meaning.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But Sosia was right. What can love bring us?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Eventually, she lay beneath his feet.
With a clank, the long chisel is dropped on the floor.
Ignoring it, Enfer walks straight to the depths of the studio, the only part of this place still drenched in darkness.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Thunderstorms can bring a different kind of stimulation. He needed inspiration, needed caprices as visceral as lightning and thunder.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: So he ignored her cries and pleas and ignored me who came following the noise... Pain can rouse the truth, and fear can elicit inspiration. He didn't hesitate to make us sacrifice for him.
Enfer glimpses at the chisel by her feet, her reminiscing gaze is filled with an icy chill.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: With the clinks of the chisel inside and the howling thunderstorms outside, eventually... he carved her fearful expression in the depths of my mind... He also completed his masterpiece...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: For the first time, I understood the meaning of fear and what it represented...
Enfer turned to look at you. Your slightly shocked expression satisfies her.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Truth, and power.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I thought that would be my end as well... Who'd have known...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Perhaps it's because he needed a witness! I was his witness who saw his breakthrough... No one could ever say he was not as good as his wife again. No one could ever mock him for not having anything to show for his work.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: He took everything she'd given him and turned it into a sculpture. His most acclaimed work, The Truthful One.
This story sounds a bit different from the one you told me in Belphegor.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hmm... Take a guess... Which one is true? Which one is false?
As long as it's told by you, either could be true.
Enfer smiles wordlessly and switches on the last light in front of her.
Under the light, every part of the entire studio is clearly visible. All kinds of sculpting tools are scattered everywhere, covered in dust and debris.
The most unsettling sight is the white sculpture standing quietly before Enfer, in the depths of the studio.
It's completely white, yet it feels twisted, dark, and cold. Both his facial expression and body language show that he's going through immense fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: As his witness and successor, surely I'll have to create a piece that can shock the entire world, just like he did.
On August 20, BR-004 erupted and your father went missing...
Which means he was...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Inspiration always dries up quickly for someone who's totally disloyal to the world and to nature...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: He found me. He told me that he loved me, so I must be like my mother and sacrifice for our family, for him...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But I'd always remembered the thunderstorm on that day.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: And so I... also made him sacrifice for my work, and just like he did... now I own a work of art praised by everyone.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Do you want to see it? The work that made my name.
Enfer reaches out a hand to you again.
She's already sealed her fear of her father in this sculpture. Then why is her hand still shaking?
You go ahead and look at it with Enfer.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: It was... an ultimate sight. Inspiration, mixed with fear, terror, and panic, was exploding.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: In that ring of red flames, I once again confirmed the feeling in my heart, confirmed the purpose of the works I'd created.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: He carved fear in the depths of my consciousness, giving me great power...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: So I, who walk in hell and peep at the truth, ought to present everything I perceive.
She says with fascination, as if once again reminiscing what she saw at that time.
But when you finally see the sculpture clearly, cold sweat breaks out on your back. Not only because of the fear oozing out from the inside of this sculpture, but also because you recognize it...
In the Witching Hour, an illusion broke Sosia's fear. And this sculpture... is the spitting image of that illusion!
Enfer... This sculpture wasn't displayed in the Witching Hour, was it?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Of course not. I've... always kept him here.
But...
Sosia's fantasy of fear was broken by him.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...That's impossible.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I've already conquered it... I won't succumb to the fear he gave me anymore. Why...?!
Through the glass shell, Enfer is glaring viciously at the sculpture she created.
Her gaze scrutinizes it slowly inch by inch, as if trying to fathom how her old self created this piece.
But as soon as she sees the chest of the sculpture, she looks dazed.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Why... is it on here as well?!
You see it clearly too. On the chest of this contorted sculpture, there's a small heart-shaped dent.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Haha... I see... I see... I was already imprisoned by weakness on that rainy night...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: That's why I... I got broken by you?!
This is her work, a piece she believes with which she conquered fear, and the reason why she is completely restrained by fear...
Enfer lets out a low laugh. Her hands press on the glass, scratching it with her nails, making an uncomfortable noise.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I should be just like him. I should become even more skillful and create a perfect piece that makes people discover their inner fear!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Let everyone witness what the world really looks like!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But why... why do I fear him?! Why am I so weak?! Why must I be restrained...?
The surrounding temperature is dropping suddenly, and the pale light bulbs are making an unpleasant electrical buzz.
The sculpture inside the glass protection remains stationary, but somehow it makes you feel like... it's waiting for a chance to charge at you.
The shackles throb in your mind, prickling your spirit. You feel a familiar power awakening.
You're not weak, and you are absolutely capable of creating a perfect piece!
If this mark is your weakness and perplexity, I'll help you find out the reason it exists and we'll resolve it together.
Your power is fluctuating. This is not a good sign. Enfer, calm down.
Enfer bows her head, as if not taking in anything you're saying.
You raise your hand to pull her back...

steps.speaker: Noise of something breaking
steps.content: Bam—!!
In a mere moment, the glass display windows surrounding the sculpture shatter amid the shaking. The darting broken glass cuts your cheek, leaving a red mark.
Enfer! Don't give in! Your ability is not stable enough now, be careful...!
Hehehe...
Rage... Marvel...
A creepy voice interrupts you. You're shocked to realize that the sculpture named "The False One" is beginning to melt like asphalt.
Enfer, your power is going out of control! It's starting to influence the surrounding art again!
You're in a very dangerous state now. Come, give me your hand!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Shut up!
The white liquid suddenly hardens and pierces right at you, forcing you backward and away from Enfer.
And while you can't approach Enfer, the melted, soft liquid wraps around her feet and begins devouring her from the bottom up.

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: I know... Only I know that you...

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You're searching for... your weakness... your perplexity!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Your mother's love... his love... makes you weak! Makes you ignorant! The biggest hindrance between you and perfection!
steps.female_content: Your mother's love... her love... makes you weak! Makes you ignorant! The biggest hindrance between you and perfection!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Come... Come to your world... Get rid of her!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Get rid of those... who make you weak...
The melted sculpture is already enveloping Enfer's neck. The shackles are throbbing and warning in your mind, alerting you to pay attention to the danger before you.
Enfer's power is too strong. When BR-004 erupted, her power entered these artworks through her creation without her knowing.
The Witching Hour has been completely devoured by Enfer, and the artworks in the Belphegor Art Museum have all been destroyed.

But as long as Enfer still exists, the power in those works will exist. This sculpture is connected to Enfer's perplexity and trauma. If it resonates with Enfer's uncontrolled power, it's very likely to trigger another Witching Hour!
Enfer! Answer me! Don't get carried away!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: The outsiders... Those people... What are they saying again?!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Don't listen to them... Go create your perfection... Get rid of your weakness!
You've just awakened as an S-Class Sinner. Perhaps you're still not capable of fully controlling this kind of power...
But I can help you! Answer me!!
Enfer doesn't respond. She's almost been completely devoured, turning into a standing white sculpture.
No!!!

steps.speaker: Jarring Noise
steps.content: Clank!
Seeing you try to wake Enfer, the wriggling liquid on the floor once again turns into spikes and charges at you.

options: Enfer! Come on, try to hear me!!

choices.text: Enfer! Come on, try to hear me!!

steps.content: The spikes' attacks are quickening, and you can only do your best to dodge them while calling to Enfer, hoping she will hear.
I'm sure you can hear me, can't you?
This is just another cocoon! Don't get sucked in!
Even if you can only struggle! You must try to jump out! Or else... you will fail again!
The spikes hit the workbench. Dust and debris fly instantly, blurring your sight.
Cough... Enfer, fear shouldn't be your only power!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Chief...
Amid the blur... you hear Enfer's voice.
But the next moment, darkness overwhelms everything. You feel the shackles on your hand throbbing, gradually fusing with the person on the other end. You know that Enfer has used her power.
